future_side: independent 50:50 marginal per map; not an estimated First Selection policy
series_assumption: IID conditional on fixed team strengths; no estimated Fearless adaptation
bootstrap_method: Independent Exp(1) weights per complete series, normalized to mean 1; same fixed hyperparameters, refit strengths and side coefficient; each simulated tournament uses one fixed parameter vector.
uncertainty_label: 90% series-cluster weighted-bootstrap model-resampling interval; not a validated frequentist coverage guarantee or a complete model-risk interval
precision_policy: Public probabilities generally one decimal percentage point; round small nonzero estimates to <0.1%, retain full machine precision in CSV.
